### Read the Bible: Numbers 35, Psalm 79, Isaiah 27, 1 John 5
Author: D.A. Carson
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/devotionals/read-the-bible/numbers-35-psalm-79-isaiah-27-1-john-5/
Passage: Numbers 35:6-34
Points:
- Six Levitical cities were designated as places of refuge to interrupt retaliatory blood feuds before a fair trial could take place.
- Scripture strictly mandates execution for deliberate murder because human beings bear the divine image.
- Manslayers found innocent of intentional malice were required to stay inside the city of refuge.
- The high priest's death marked a transition that freed the manslayer, foreshadowing Christ's death to atone for sin.

### Bible Pathways - Feb. 28, 2008
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-feb-28-2008-11569369.html
Passage: Numbers 35:6-34
Points:
- God commanded Israel to establish refuge cities to shield those responsible for accidental deaths from avengers.
- An accidental killer had to remain within the refuge boundaries until the high priest died.
- Willful murderers received no sanctuary, as leaving murder unpunished defiles the land.
- The high priest's death pictured the atonement of Christ, who serves as our refuge from judgment.
